answer: The design leans on invitation quota tree, reduced by each unverified claim, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ferrous of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A hollow of per-task receipts records who did what, and the river of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
